profile.headline: Software Engineer at Aries Systems Corporation (an Elsevier company)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Member of the Shared Services team within Bond & Specialty Insurance

positions.title: Writing Mentor
positions.description: I worked individually with students to improve their writing and presentation skills. Appointments were 30 minutes to 1 hour and required me to identify issues that the student was facing and utilize active listening and constructive criticism skills to best help them with their assignment. My goal as a peer mentor was to give students transferable skills that they can apply to future assignments and use to improve their overall writing skills.

company.name: Speaking, Arguing, Writing Center Mount Holyoke College

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: I was a TA for a Google-hosted Android App Development workshop. The class was made up of ten students that I helped with various concepts such as learning Android Studio and Git, working through the design process for a final project, and discussing the logic of their programs. I was required to coordinate my work with two other TAs and the class instructor.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: I worked in a cell-biology research lab which focused on cell-death regulating genes and proteins. My responsibilities included aiding senior researchers with their projects, culturing cells, running gels, and performing Western Blots.
